A.desc: the original VALHALLA values (a pad), level-matched: a reference, not a candidate

B.desc: van-true short plink: AMP DECAY 64, light tape (CHEW 25)

C.desc: plink with a short ring: AMP DECAY 89, medium tape (CHEW 45)

D.desc: FINGERSYM-style long ring: AMP DECAY 101, heavier tape (CHEW 65), the delayed LFO shimmer (TRI 0.8 Hz, pitch +-9.4 cents, amp 40, delay 40, PHASE SYNC)

Ebox.desc: calibration: C with a nearer-harmonic interval (OSC 2 +12 st, FINE 70, X-MOD 0, LEVEL 50)

Fmetal.desc: calibration: C with a strongly inharmonic interval (OSC 2 +17 st, LEVEL 100, X-MOD 70)

Dfinal.desc: the APPROVED version: variant D with CHEW 0 (no tape at all), everything else as D
